preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 5000 for N, M1, M2 in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of cities N is between 2 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= M1 <= 20000 for N, M1, M2 in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of roads proposed by other companies M1 is between 1 and 20000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= M2 <= 20000 for N, M1, M2 in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of roads proposed by Chef's company M2 is between 1 and 20000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c <= 1000000000 for N, M1, M2, other_roads, chef_roads in test_cases for u, v, c in other_roads + chef_roads)
preconditions.description: For each road, the cost c is between 0 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == 'Impossible' or (isinstance(result, tuple) and len(result) == 2 and isinstance(result[0], int) and isinstance(result[1], int)) for result in results)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the result is either 'Impossible' or a tuple of two integers.

postconditions.expression: all(result != 'Impossible' or (N, M1, M2, other_roads, chef_roads) in impossible_cases for N, M1, M2, other_roads, chef_roads, result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: If the result is 'Impossible', the test case configuration is one where it is impossible to connect all cities with a single path of roads.

postconditions.expression: all(result == 'Impossible' or (is_connected(N, selected_roads) and len(selected_roads) == N - 1) for N, M1, M2, other_roads, chef_roads, result in zip(test_cases, results) for selected_roads in [other_roads + chef_roads if result != 'Impossible' else []])
postconditions.description: If the result is not 'Impossible', the selected roads form a single connected component with exactly N-1 roads.

postconditions.expression: all(result == 'Impossible' or result[0] == max_profit(N, other_roads, chef_roads) for N, M1, M2, other_roads, chef_roads, result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: If the result is not 'Impossible', the first element of the result is the maximum profit Chef can gain.

postconditions.expression: all(result == 'Impossible' or result[1] == min_total_cost(N, other_roads, chef_roads, result[0]) for N, M1, M2, other_roads, chef_roads, result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: If the result is not 'Impossible', the second element of the result is the minimum total cost of the chosen roads that yields the maximum profit.
